## ✅ Pull Request Checklist

Before submitting this PR, please check and confirm all of the following:

- [ ] **Code Correctness:** My code compiles locally without errors or warnings.
- [ ] **Formatting:** My code follows standard C++ formatting guidelines (indentation, camelCase/snake_case consistency).
- [ ] **No Dead Code:** I have removed all commented-out debug code, unused headers, and redundant code.
- [ ] **Self-Reviewed:** I have read through my changes and ensured they are clean and readable.
- [ ] **Documentation:** I have added comments to explain non-obvious logic, and updated the `README.md` mapping table if a new file was added.
- [ ] **No Regression:** My changes do not break any existing functionality.
